messages:
jane-auditor: Hi team — auditor request: we need a forensics-style replay + artifact bundle for the RBAC change that rolled 2024-11-15 03:12 UTC (service-account perms tightened). Deliverables: who changed, exact commits/PRs, approvals, deployment IDs, related KMS key rotation metadata, and any post-change incidents. Prefer a single export (signed) and a mapping to SOC2/ISO controls. Deadline EOW PT, please.

maya-sec: Acknowledged. We can produce a replay and an evidence bundle. Quick Q: do you want raw audit logs (Splunk) + redacted payloads, or a curated package with narrative + hashes?

jane-auditor: Curated package + narrative + sha256 hashes for all artifacts please. Also need proof of access approvals (who clicked approve in PR).

samir-sre: We have a playbook run for that change: playbook-run-id=pb-20241115-3892. We can export kube audit events, IAM change events, and deploy pipeline logs. Export command we use internally:

```
/rwe-export --type=compliance --run pb-20241115-3892 --components kubernetes,audit,deploy,pki --format=zip --redact=pii --sign
```

Outputs go to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/pb-20241115-3892.zip (pre-sign). evidence-bot will sign and checksum.

olivia-eng: For the PRs: github.com/redwood/platform/pulls/4827 (RBAC policy change) — approvals: carla-sec, jen-prod. CI job ids: ci/4827/78, ci/4827/79. The PR description references KMS alias change to alias/redwood-prod-2024-rot.

jen-prod: Confirmed I approved the PR on 2024-11-14 22:58 PT. Adding note: change was gated behind canary for 30m, no errors.

maya-sec: KMS rotation metadata: key version ids and rotation timestamp are available via our KMS audit view. Example row (redacted):

```
key_alias: alias/redwood-prod-2024-rot
rotation_time: 2024-11-14T21:05:03Z
previous_key_id: xxxxx-REDACTED-01
current_key_id: xxxxx-REDACTED-02
rotation_procedure: automated-rotation-v2
```

We will include the KMS audit export CSV and a hash manifest.

evidence-bot: evidence-bundle prepared: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/pb-20241115-3892-bundle.zip 
sha256: 3f2a9c8b... (signed by evidence-bot).

samir-sre: Also attaching the incident correlation link: INC-20241115-7 — flagged a transient token-exchange error 03:21 UTC that auto-healed. We'll include the incident timeline and the mitigation notes. Note: the error did not expose secrets, see redaction note in bundle.

olivia-eng: Quick audit query we used (splunk-like syntax):

```
index=k8s_audit action=update resource=rbac.authorization.k8s.io|json | search user="svc-deployer" earliest="2024-11-14:21:00:00" latest="2024-11-15:04:00:00" | table _time user verb resourceName requestURI changeRequestID
```

We'll include raw query and exported CSV in the bundle.

maya-sec: Control mapping: we will map artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 (change management), CC7.1 (logical access), and ISO A.9.2/A.10.1 as applicable. We'll attach a one-page matrix.

jane-auditor: Can you also include the signed PR approval screenshot or audit trail showing the approval action? That's required for our evidence.

olivia-eng: Yes — we'll include the GitHub audit event (redacted) and a screenshot saved as png. Link in bundle: /evidence/4827-approvals.png.

samir-sre: Note on retention: the raw audit logs are retained 18 months in splunk; we will include a subset for the window you asked. If you later need longer retention exports, we can request a bulk pull.

maya-sec: One more note: we replaced raw key ids in public artifacts with alias placeholders. The signed bundle will contain a separate encrypted manifest (KMS-encrypted) listing the real key ids for internal reviewers only.

jane-auditor: That works. Please upload the signed bundle and the one-page control mapping to the shared dropbox and reply here when done. I will confirm receipt. Deadline EOW PT still fine. Thanks. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: upload complete -> https://dropbox.redwood.com/s/secure/pb-20241115-3892-signed.zip (access auditor_jane, maya-sec, samir-sre).

jen-prod: Done — PR link + approvals included.

jane-auditor: Received and validating. If anything else pops up I'll ping. Thanks everyone.
